depiction.primary_object: rectangular speech bubble outline containing a solid video camera
depiction.composition: centered video camera silhouette inside an outlined chat bubble with bottom-left tail

readings.meaning: video call, video chat, or online meeting (Zoom, FaceTime, Meet)
telehealth appointment or remote video consultation
remote video interview or live webinar

ambiguity: Can be confused with the speech bubble containing a play button for tasks about asynchronous video messages, or with a plain video camera icon when the chat bubble outline isn't noticed.

reasoning: A speech bubble containing a video camera universally represents video calls (Zoom, FaceTime, Meet, telehealth) and asynchronous video messages (Loom, video chats). These are very common everyday tasks across work, family, learning, and healthcare, and the speech bubble clearly distinguishes it from filming or watching video.
